name: Floral Symbol
instruction: Design a 3D model of a floral symbol with five petals. The petals should be evenly spaced and symmetrical.

Shape accuracy: The object in the model is a floral symbol.
The floral symbol has five distinct petals.
The petals are evenly spaced around the center.
Color representation: The color set in the script is reasonable for the object.
Size: The size set in the script is reasonable for the object.
Proportion: The size of each petal is proportionate to the overall size of the floral symbol.
The center of the flower is proportionate to the petals.
Texture and surface detail: The texture and surface detail set in the script is reasonable for the object.

Three-dimensional spatial awareness: The petals are positioned correctly to create a balanced appearance.
The center of the flower is clearly defined and supports the petals.
Object distance and contact: There is no overlap between the petals.
Each petal connects seamlessly to the center.

Instruction execution accuracy: All specified attributes of the floral symbol are accurately represented.
The model adheres to the requirement of having five petals.
